answer.reason: The studio glossary in ARCHITECTURE.md names all seven firing stages (queued, drying, heating, soaking, easing, done, broken) and gives each one a studio rule, such as take-back allowed, the kiln room closed to students, or a free re-fire. That makes the set domain-owned, even though it maps one-for-one onto KilnwisePhase. PieceService also branches on these stages under studio rules, for example
